newsitem.title: FINLAND: TURKISTUOTTAJAT SAYS FOX PELT PRICES DOWN.
newsitem.headline: TURKISTUOTTAJAT SAYS FOX PELT PRICES DOWN.

text.p: Finnish fur auctioneer Turkistuottajat Oy said on Monday it had auctioned almost all 350,000 blue fox pelts offered, but prices were down by 20 to 35 percent from last season.

"The median price for Finnish pelts was 400 markka. Dollar prices have fallen from last selling season's peak level by over 20 percent and up to 35 percent depending on the quality," Turkistuottajat said in a statement.
The trend in prices was in line with that seen at a fur auction in Copenhagen a few weeks ago, Turkistuottajat said.

The decline in prices is explained by last year's peak, the sluggish start in retails this year owing to the late winter and increased pelt production, managing director Pirkko Rantanen-Kervinen said in the statement.
